name: lazylibrarian
title: LazyLibrarian
description: Follows authors and finds their e-books, audiobooks and magazines through your indexers and download client, then files them in your library. After deploying, open Config: set the e-book folder to /books and the download folder to /downloads, add a download client and at least one provider. It has no sign-in until you set a user name and password under Config > Interface.

variables.name: LAZYLIBRARIAN_DOWNLOADS
variables.label: Downloads folder
variables.description: The folder on this server your download client saves into, mounted at /downloads

variables.name: LAZYLIBRARIAN_BOOKS
variables.label: Books folder
variables.description: The folder on this server your book library lives in, mounted at /books
